summary: Weave Communications filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive merger agreement with Francisco Partners affiliates (Willow Parent and Merger Sub) to acquire the company for $7.40 per share in cash, a going-private transaction. The board unanimously approved the deal and recommends stockholders adopt it, submitting it for stockholder approval. The merger consideration converts each share into $7.40 cash, excluding dissenting/treasury/subsidiary/Parent shares. Stock options will be cashed out based on spread. Post-close, shares will be delisted from NYSE and deregistered. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory approvals; risk-arb spread depends on deal timeline and potential competing bids.
